# UI round 1 — candidate C — DECISIONS

Every judgment call the prompt (`docs/handoff/ui-rebuild-round1-build-prompt.md`) left open, with the alternative rejected. Dates absolute; today is 2026-09-18.

| # | Decision | Alternative rejected | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-01 | **Baseline = the dirty `phase1-productname-pivot` working tree**, imported as the first commit on `candidate-c` (`3ab2164`). | Start from the committed tip `7c73fb8` as §0 literally says. | The tip has none of the student-beta work (`FirstRun.tsx`, `views/`, `sync-study-sources.mjs`, study core). `docs/build/student-beta/STATUS.md` describes the *dirty tree* as the integrated state, and this prompt extends files that only exist there. Nothing was committed to phase1 or main. |
| D-02 | **Tick weights + term inference computed in JS at sync time** (`browser/scripts/lib/semester.mjs`, 9 tests) and written into schema-2 JSON; **`read_semester` is native Rust** (`semester.rs`, no Python hop). | Compute in Python in the daemon; or compute in React. | The sync already holds the raw Canvas payloads (groups, points), so weight is a property of the synced record; the Home read is then a JSON fold with no process spawn (< 5 ms) — the opposite of the Plan-tab problem. React never sees Canvas payloads. |
| D-03 | Weighted courses: `share = (group_weight / Σ weights of groups that have pointed items) × points / group points`. Unweighted: `points / Σ points`. Zero-point/ungraded → 0 (min tick). | Use `group_weight/100` literally. | Canvas grades out of the sum of weights that actually have graded items; renormalising means shares sum to 1 for what the student can see (asserted in tests). |
| D-04 | Kind classification: `exam` if title matches `exam|midterm|final|test`; else `quiz` if `quiz` in title, `is_quiz_assignment`, `online_quiz`, or a Canvas quiz object; `discussion` if `discussion_topic`; `other` if no submission and no points; else `assignment`. Exams outrank quizzes ("Final Exam" delivered as a quiz is an exam). | Reuse only `EXAM_TITLE_RE` (which lumps quizzes with exams). | The line needs quizzes and exams distinguishable; existing `examCandidates` is untouched for the study core. |
| D-05 | **Course palette = the dataviz reference categorical set** (8 slots, light + dark steps), assigned by FNV-1a hash of the course id with forward-walk collision resolution across the sync's sorted course list. Validated with `dataviz/scripts/validate_palette.js`: all hard gates pass on Paper `#faf8f3`, Night `#0c1018`, Forest `#0b1410`, Contrast `#000000` (worst adjacent CVD ΔE 9.1 light / 8.4 dark; normal-vision 19.6 / 19.3). Light-mode contrast WARN on aqua/yellow/magenta is relieved by the visible course label on every row. Hexes in `semester.mjs`. | Okabe-Ito (black slot unusable on dark), Tol bright (7 slots). | Ran the validator instead of eyeballing. |
| D-06 | Term window: Canvas `course.end_at` ?? `term.end_at` → source `canvas`; else last due + 7 d → `inferred`; `mixed` when one end is Canvas and the other inferred; `none` when nothing. The row shows "term inferred from due dates" / "no term dates". | Silently infer. | §1.2: "show nothing that implies certainty you don't have". |
| D-07 | Range windows start **7 days before today** (`PAST_CONTEXT_DAYS`) so overdue / just-finished items stay visible, dimmed; Full semester spans earliest term start → latest term end. | Start exactly at today. | "Ticks in the past are dimmed" is meaningless if nothing past is drawn. |
| D-08 | `read_semester` takes the renderer's local `today` (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only; the study core still forbids a renderer clock. | UTC today in Rust (no chrono). | The line must be drawn in the student's day; adding a tz dependency for a read view was not worth it. |
| D-09 | Tick height = `6 + 38·√(min(share, 0.3)/0.3)` px, kind floors exam 30 / quiz 16, widths 5/3/2 px, exam diamond cap, quiz dot cap, discussion dashed, ungraded 50 % opacity; hit target 12 px wide, full row height. | Linear scale. | √ keeps small homework visibly different while a 30 % final hits the cap; floors keep a 0-point quiz readable as a quiz. |
| D-10 | **Cluster threshold 7 px** (Q4): small ticks whose centre is within 7 px of the previous group at the current track width collapse into one hoverable group showing a count; exams and quizzes never cluster; bubble lists members. | Cluster by day. | Pixel distance is what makes hover impossible; recomputed on resize. |
| D-11 | Hover bubble: fixed-position glass, shown on `mouseenter`/`focus` with no delay, 140 ms grace to move into the bubble, clamped to the viewport. Keyboard: ←/→ move along the row, Enter/Space open the popup, Esc blurs. | Portal + popper library. | No new dependency; clamping is two `Math.min`s. |
| D-12 | The click popup fetches `read_exam_prep` for **any** item to show its synced description; "View plan" only for exam/quiz. | Separate `read_item` command. | Same data, one command. |
| D-13 | **Sync progress = NDJSON on the script's stdout**, forwarded by Rust as `study-sync-progress` window events (`courses` / `course` / `done`). | Polled progress file. | No polling loop, no partial-file races, humans can read the stream. |
| D-14 | `sync_study_sources` **then runs `canvas-import` for every synced course with ≥ 1 source**, then kicks the deep week sync in the background. | Keep a manual "Use in Study" import button. | "Import a source" is gone; Canvas sync is the only ingestion path. Student-authored items survive the re-import when their sources still exist (existing study-core behaviour). PHYS 1110-style courses with no text are skipped, honestly. |
| D-15 | **Every process-spawning Tauri command is `#[tauri::command(async)]`.** | Only batch the reads. | Sync commands run on the main thread in Tauri 2; six Python spawns there froze the webview — the real reason "clicking Plan doesn't work". Batching alone would still block for one spawn. |
| D-16 | Plan tab reads batched into **one Python process** (`canvas_mcp.core.plan_surface`, each section try/except-isolated) exposed as `read_plan_surface`. | Six parallel threads from Rust. | Measured on this machine (fresh profile): six processes 4.12 s → one 0.64 s (`daemon::round1_tests::plan_surface_is_one_process_not_six`). A missing state file now degrades one section instead of the tab. |
| D-17 | Calendar tab keeps the due-checks surface (`Top3Sticky`/`ReviewSession`) under the commitment, and folds Trail/Garden/Retention/Evaluation into a collapsed "Learning record". | Drop them. | They are the learning loop's entry points (out of scope to redesign, in scope to keep reachable). |
| D-18 | `open_external` = macOS `/usr/bin/open` (xdg-open / `cmd /c start` elsewhere), **https only**, no new plugin. | `tauri-plugin-opener`. | Zero new deps under `--locked`; the allowlist is stricter than the plugin's default scope. |
| D-19 | Local calendar = append-only `inbox/calendar.jsonl` with tombstones; suggestions contract `inbox/calendar-suggestions.jsonl` `{source_message_id,title,start,end,confidence,why}`; decisions in `inbox/calendar-suggestion-decisions.jsonl`. Producer (Gmail triage) **not built** (Q3: confirm account scope first). | SQLite. | Matches the existing `ledger.jsonl` idiom; trivially inspectable. |
| D-20 | The existing guarded Google Calendar preview→confirm flow (`PlanEvent`) moves to **Settings → Calendar and email** instead of being deleted. | Delete it (it lost its only importer). | It is the ConfirmationGuard seam the prompt says to keep documented; removing working guarded code is not a UI decision. |
| D-21 | Exam Prep plan = `deterministic-split-v1`: sources (pages + assignment descriptions dated before the exam, course order) spread evenly across the days until the exam; gap days become "Revisit" of the last material; last day = Review; seed shifts the split without inventing sources; empty plan when no material. | Fill gaps with generic advice. | Every focus row points at a synced source id (asserted). |
| D-22 | "Let's test your knowledge" routes to Study with the course preselected when `study.status().courses` contains the course; otherwise an honest empty state. | Always route. | A fake quiz is forbidden. |
| D-23 | The old `SourcesView` (templates, paste-a-packet, author-a-question, manual exam dates) is **removed**; Settings → Canvas data is read-only inspection + "Sync Canvas now". | Keep authoring under Settings. | Authoring is an import flow in different clothes. The study-core commands remain for CLI/tests; a future round can expose authoring where it belongs. |
| D-24 | Legal text lives only in `docs/legal/*.md`, imported with Vite `?raw`; `legal.ts` keeps a 1-paragraph per-school preamble. Vitest needs `server.fs.strict:false` for the out-of-root import. | Copy the text into TS. | Single source, as required. |
| D-25 | Desktop-only: `ipc.ts` has no `!isTauri()` product paths; tests mock the module. `isTauri()` remains only for the study dev bridge (a developer tool for plain `vite`). | Delete `isTauri` entirely. | The dev bridge is not a product path. |
| D-26 | Screenshots come from a **dev-only harness** (`app/dev/fixture.html` + `tauri-shim.ts` shimming `window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__` over the test fixtures) captured with Playwright + system Chrome. The native app was launched and verified via daemon logs, but this process has no Screen Recording / Accessibility permission, so native-window screenshots and clicks were impossible. | Ship nothing visual. | The harness runs the real bundle; it is excluded from the production build (`index.html` is the only rollup input). |
| D-27 | The `check_canvas_session` / `bootstrap_canvas_sync` commands were missing from `build.rs` and `capabilities/default.json`; added. | Leave as-is. | Found while registering new commands (see AUDIT A-01). |
| D-28 | Children always receive `DEV_USER_ROOT=<resolved root>` (`runtime.rs apply_env`). | Only forward it when the parent had it. | A JS child otherwise resolved the default profile while Rust used a boot-time one; the stub e2e test caught it writing a marker into the default profile (removed). |
| D-29 | Type scale tokens `--text-xs/sm/md/lg/xl` applied to everything under `.workspace-main`; no global button restyle (only the Accept toggle's filled state was fixed, as asked). | Restyle buttons. | Jacob wants that gradual. |
| D-30 | `#root`/`body`/`.workspace-main` paint `--surface-solid` (was `transparent`). | Keep transparent for vibrancy. | The window is opaque now (`tauri.conf.json transparent:false`); transparent bodies were the white-below-Settings bug. |
